advancements.aquamirae.encounter_the_shi.en: Encounter the most fearsome inhabitant of the Ice Maze
advancements.aquamirae.encounter_the_shi.zh: 遭遇大漩涡中最令人畏惧的居民
advancements.aquamirae.encounter_the_shi.vi: Gặp phải những cư dân đáng sợ nhất của Maelstrom

advancements.aquamirae.obtain_ship_grave.en: Collect the eerie trace left behind by the Shipbreaker
advancements.aquamirae.obtain_ship_grave.zh: 收集破船者留下的诡异踪迹
advancements.aquamirae.obtain_ship_grave.vi: Thu thập những dấu vết kỳ quái do bọn phá tàu để lại

effect.aquamirae.fury_of_the_depths.vi: Cơn thịnh nộ của vực sâu

effect.aquamirae.resilience_of_the_depth.vi: Sự dẻo dai của biển sâu

death.attack.shipbreaker.en: The echo of %1$s's life fades through the Ice Maze...
death.attack.shipbreaker.zh: %1$s 的生命回响在寒冰迷宫中渐渐消散……
death.attack.shipbreaker.vi: Tiếng vọng về cuộc đời của %1$s dần dần tan biến trong mê cung băng...

death.attack.crystallization.en: %1$s has been turned into a crystal

tooltip.aquamirae.shell_horn.en: [color=light_purple]Summons Captain Cornelia.[/color] [/br][/br] Can be used near water in the Ice Maze.
tooltip.aquamirae.shell_horn.zh: [color=light_purple]召唤船长科妮莉亚。[/color] [/br][/br] 可在寒冰迷宫的水域附近使用。
tooltip.aquamirae.shell_horn.vi: [color=light_purple]Triệu hồi Đội trưởng Cornelia. [/color] [/br][/br] Có thể sử dụng gần nước trong Mê cung băng.

tooltip.aquamirae.jellyfish_jelly.en: A Scuttler's favorite treat. Some simply can't stop eating it.
tooltip.aquamirae.jellyfish_jelly.zh: 爬行者最喜欢的零食。有些家伙就是停不下来。
tooltip.aquamirae.jellyfish_jelly.vi: Món ăn vặt yêu thích của Creepers. Một số kẻ không thể dừng lại.

config.aquamirae.option.shell_horn_usage.en:
Controls where the Shell Horn can be used.

§fEVERYWHERE§7 – The Shell Horn can be used anywhere.

§fICE_MAZE§7 – The Shell Horn can only be used within the Ice Maze, regardless of dimension.

§fTHE_MAELSTROM§7 – The Shell Horn can only be used in The Maelstrom dimension.
config.aquamirae.option.shell_horn_usage.zh:
控制贝壳号角的使用地点。

§f任意位置§7 – 贝壳号角可在任何地方使用。

§f寒冰迷宫§7 – 贝壳号角只能在寒冰迷宫内使用，不限维度。

§f大漩涡§7 – 贝壳号角只能在大漩涡维度中使用。
config.aquamirae.option.shell_horn_usage.vi:
Kiểm soát nơi Shell Horn được sử dụng.

§f ở mọi nơi§7 – Shell Horn có thể được sử dụng ở mọi nơi.

§f Mê cung băng§7 – Sừng vỏ sò chỉ có thể được sử dụng trong Mê cung băng, bất kể kích thước.

§f Maelstrom§7 – Shell Horn chỉ có thể được sử dụng trong chiều không gian Maelstrom.

config.aquamirae.option.shell_horn_searc.en: How far from the point of use to search for a valid location to spawn Captain Cornelia.
config.aquamirae.option.shell_horn_searc.zh: 从使用点出发搜索有效位置以生成船长科妮莉亚的范围。
config.aquamirae.option.shell_horn_searc.vi: Tìm kiếm các vị trí hợp lệ từ điểm sử dụng để tạo ra phạm vi của Captain Cornelia.

config.aquamirae.option.shell_horn_spawn.en: Vertical offset of Captain Cornelia's spawn position from the water surface.
config.aquamirae.option.shell_horn_spawn.zh: 船长科妮莉亚生成位置相对于水面的垂直偏移。
config.aquamirae.option.shell_horn_spawn.vi: Độ lệch dọc của vị trí sinh sản của Thuyền trưởng Cornelia so với mặt nước.

config.aquamirae.option.shell_horn_summo.en: Delay between using the Shell Horn and spawning Captain Cornelia or reporting a failed summon.
config.aquamirae.option.shell_horn_summo.zh: 使用贝壳号角到生成船长科妮莉亚或报告召唤失败之间的延迟。
config.aquamirae.option.shell_horn_summo.vi: Sự chậm trễ giữa việc sử dụng Shellhorn và thời gian Thuyền trưởng Cornelia được sinh ra hoặc lỗi triệu hồi được báo cáo.

config.aquamirae.option.shell_horn_coold.en: Cooldown between attempts to use the Shell Horn.
config.aquamirae.option.shell_horn_coold.zh: 尝试使用贝壳号角的冷却间隔。
config.aquamirae.option.shell_horn_coold.vi: Hãy thử sử dụng khoảng thời gian hồi chiêu của Shell Horn.

config.aquamirae.option.remnant_saber_pe.vi: Tiền thưởng cho mỗi lần tiêu diệt

config.aquamirae.option.terrible_blade_r.vi: mức độ phục hồi sự sống
thời gian phục hồi sức khỏe

config.aquamirae.option.biome_spawner_mo.en:
Controls how Aquamirae spawns are added to biomes tagged with aquamirae:ice_maze.

§fOVERRIDE§7 – Replaces all existing spawns with Aquamirae spawns.

§fMERGE§7 – Adds Aquamirae spawns while keeping existing spawns.

§fNONE§7 – Disables Aquamirae spawns entirely.
config.aquamirae.option.biome_spawner_mo.zh:
控制 Aquamirae 生物如何添加到标记为 aquamirae:ice_maze 的生物群系中。

§f覆盖§7 – 用 Aquamirae 生物替换所有现有生成。

§f合并§7 – 在保留现有生成的同时添加 Aquamirae 生物。

§f无§7 – 完全禁用 Aquamirae 生物的生成。
config.aquamirae.option.biome_spawner_mo.vi:
Kiểm soát cách thêm sinh vật Aquamirae vào quần xã được gắn thẻ aquamirae:ice_maze.

§f ghi đè §7 - Thay thế tất cả các sinh vật hiện có bằng sinh vật Aquamirae.

§f Hợp nhất §7 – Thêm sinh vật Aquamirae trong khi vẫn giữ lại các sinh vật hiện có.

§f không có §7 – Vô hiệu hóa hoàn toàn việc sinh sản của các sinh vật Aquamirae.

config.aquamirae.option.enable_spawning..en: Whether this mob can spawn through the Aquamirae spawning system.
config.aquamirae.option.enable_spawning..zh: 此生物是否可以通过 Aquamirae 生成系统生成。
config.aquamirae.option.enable_spawning..vi: Liệu mob này có thể được sinh ra thông qua hệ thống sinh sản Aquamirae hay không.

config.aquamirae.option.spawn_weight.des.en: How frequently this mob spawns relative to other mobs.
config.aquamirae.option.spawn_weight.des.zh: 此生物相对于其他生物的生成频率。
config.aquamirae.option.spawn_weight.des.vi: Tần suất sinh sản của mob này so với các mob khác.

config.aquamirae.option.spawn_min_count..en: Minimum number of this mob spawned in a group.
config.aquamirae.option.spawn_min_count..zh: 每组生成此生物的最小数量。
config.aquamirae.option.spawn_min_count..vi: Số lượng tối thiểu mob này sinh ra trong mỗi nhóm.

config.aquamirae.option.spawn_max_count..en: Maximum number of this mob spawned in a group.
config.aquamirae.option.spawn_max_count..zh: 每组生成此生物的最大数量。
config.aquamirae.option.spawn_max_count..vi: Số lượng tối đa của mob này sinh ra trong mỗi nhóm.

config.aquamirae.label.missing_config_hi.en: Can't find the configuration you're looking for? Feel free to ask for help or request a new configuration on the %s Discord server.
config.aquamirae.label.missing_config_hi.zh: 找不到你想要的配置？欢迎在 %s Discord 服务器上寻求帮助或请求新配置。
config.aquamirae.label.missing_config_hi.vi: Không thể tìm thấy cấu hình bạn muốn? Vui lòng yêu cầu trợ giúp hoặc yêu cầu cấu hình mới trên máy chủ Discord %s.

ability.aquamirae.tempest_trident.en: Your attacks inflict Superconductor for {duration} seconds. Striking an affected enemy triggers a chain discharge that jumps to nearby affected enemies, shocking them for {shock_duration} seconds. When lightning strikes an affected enemy, it also strikes nearby affected enemies.
ability.aquamirae.tempest_trident.zh: 你的攻击会使目标触电，持续 {duration} 秒。攻击受影响的敌人会引发连锁放电，跳跃至附近的受影响敌人，使其麻痹 {shock_duration} 秒。当闪电击中受影响的敌人时，也会同时击中附近的受影响敌人。
ability.aquamirae.tempest_trident.vi: Các đòn tấn công của bạn khiến mục tiêu bị điện giật trong {duration} giây. Tấn công kẻ địch bị ảnh hưởng sẽ kích hoạt một chuỗi phóng điện nhảy sang kẻ địch bị ảnh hưởng ở gần, làm chúng tê liệt trong {shock_duration} giây. Khi sét đánh vào kẻ địch bị ảnh hưởng, nó cũng sẽ tấn công những kẻ địch bị ảnh hưởng ở gần.

ability.aquamirae.jawbreaker.en: Can be consumed as food, reducing its durability by {durability}.
ability.aquamirae.jawbreaker.zh: 可作为食物食用，每次消耗 {durability} 点耐久度。
ability.aquamirae.jawbreaker.vi: Có thể dùng làm thức ăn, mỗi lần tiêu tốn {độ bền} điểm.

advancements.aquamirae.root.description.en: Explore the ship graveyard and its terrifying creatures
advancements.aquamirae.root.description.zh: 探索海船墓地及其中令人恐惧的生物

advancements.aquamirae.find_ice_maze.des.en: Enter the Ice Maze that covers the Deep Frozen Ocean biome
advancements.aquamirae.find_ice_maze.des.zh: 进入覆盖深寒海洋生物群系的寒冰迷宫

advancements.aquamirae.obtain_niveis_tea.en: Distill the essence of Wisteria Niveis into a tear that calls forth the Maelstrom
advancements.aquamirae.obtain_niveis_tea.zh: 将雪紫藤的精华蒸馏成一滴能够召唤大漩涡的泪珠

advancements.aquamirae.find_the_maelstro.en: Let the blizzard carry you away

advancements.aquamirae.tame_shellback.de.en: Raise a Scuttler into a mighty Shellback and tame it as your mount
advancements.aquamirae.tame_shellback.de.zh: 将一只爬行者养成强大的甲壳兽，并将其驯服为坐骑

advancements.aquamirae.obtain_shell_horn.en: Discover a Shell Horn while exploring frozen pirate ships
advancements.aquamirae.obtain_shell_horn.zh: 探索冰冻的海盗船时发现一个贝壳号角

advancements.aquamirae.obtain_frozen_key.en: Claim the key from the restless Ghost of Captain Cornelia
advancements.aquamirae.obtain_frozen_key.zh: 从船长科妮莉亚不安的亡灵手中夺得钥匙

advancements.aquamirae.obtain_pirate_pou.en: Find an abandoned Pirate Pouch somewhere in the Ice Maze
advancements.aquamirae.obtain_pirate_pou.zh: 在寒冰迷宫的某处找到一个被遗弃的海盗袋子

advancements.aquamirae.obtain_all_salvag.en: Get a full suit of Salvager Armor

advancements.aquamirae.obtain_rune_of_th.en: Find an ancient rune buried beneath the frozen depths of the Ice Maze
advancements.aquamirae.obtain_rune_of_th.zh: 找到埋藏于寒冰迷宫冰冻深处的远古符文

advancements.aquamirae.obtain_tidepierce.en: Loot the Tidepiercer from the fallen Ghost of Captain Cornelia
advancements.aquamirae.obtain_tidepierce.zh: 从倒下的船长科妮莉亚亡灵手中夺取潮汐穿刺者

advancements.aquamirae.obtain_terrible_u.en: Obtain a Terrible Upgrade Smithing Template
advancements.aquamirae.obtain_terrible_u.zh: 获得一个可怖升级锻造模板

advancements.aquamirae.obtain_all_terrib.en: Get a full suit of Terrible Armor

advancements.aquamirae.obtain_abyssal_up.en: Obtain an Abyssal Upgrade Smithing Template
advancements.aquamirae.obtain_abyssal_up.zh: 获得一个深海升级锻造模板

advancements.aquamirae.obtain_all_abyssa.en: Get a full suit of Abyssal Armor

ability.aquamirae.terrible_armor.half.en: Attackers are inflicted with Poison {amplifier} for {duration} seconds.
ability.aquamirae.terrible_armor.half.zh: 攻击者会受到中毒 {amplifier}，持续 {duration} 秒。

ability.aquamirae.terrible_armor.full.en: Taking damage in water grants Dolphin's Grace {amplifier} for {duration} seconds.
ability.aquamirae.terrible_armor.full.zh: 在水中受到伤害会获得海豚的恩惠 {amplifier}，持续 {duration} 秒。

ability.aquamirae.abyssal_armor.half.en: Whenever you gain a negative effect, gain Strength for {duration} seconds, stacking up to Strength {max_stacks}.
ability.aquamirae.abyssal_armor.half.zh: 每当你获得负面效果时，获得力量，持续 {duration} 秒，最多叠加至力量 {max_stacks}。

ability.aquamirae.abyssal_armor.full_hea.en: Damaging an enemy provokes nearby monsters to target you instead of other players.
ability.aquamirae.abyssal_armor.full_hea.zh: 对敌人造成伤害会激怒附近的怪物，使其转而攻击你而非其他玩家。

ability.aquamirae.abyssal_armor.full_tia.en: Taking fatal damage defers your death for {duration} seconds. During this time, your damage dealt and attack speed are reduced by {debuff}.
ability.aquamirae.abyssal_armor.full_tia.zh: 受到致命伤害时，死亡会延迟 {duration} 秒。在此期间，你造成的伤害和攻击速度降低 {debuff}。

ability.aquamirae.salvager_armor.full.en: Supplies air underwater and prevents freezing in the icy waters of the Ice Maze.

ability.aquamirae.remnant_saber.en: Your attacks deal {base_bonus} increased damage to Ice Maze creatures. Each Ice Maze creature you have ever slain permanently increases this bonus by {per_kill}, up to {max_bonus}.
ability.aquamirae.remnant_saber.zh: 你的攻击对寒冰迷宫生物造成额外 {base_bonus} 伤害。你每击杀一只寒冰迷宫生物，此加成永久增加 {per_kill}，最多增加至 {max_bonus}。

ability.aquamirae.terrible_blade.base.en: Your attacks inflict Poison {amplifier} for {duration} seconds.
ability.aquamirae.terrible_blade.base.zh: 你的攻击会使敌人中毒 {amplifier}，持续 {duration} 秒。

ability.aquamirae.terrible_blade.full.en: Defeating poisoned enemies grants Regeneration {amplifier} for {duration} seconds.
ability.aquamirae.terrible_blade.full.zh: 击败中毒的敌人会获得生命恢复 {amplifier}，持续 {duration} 秒。

ability.aquamirae.terrible_fang.base.en: Your attacks deal {bonus} increased damage. Each empty heart grants {per_heart}, up to {max_bonus}.
ability.aquamirae.terrible_fang.base.zh: 你的攻击造成额外 {bonus} 伤害。每缺少一颗心的生命值，伤害增加 {per_heart}，最多增加至 {max_bonus}。

ability.aquamirae.terrible_fang.full.en: The damage bonus is doubled against enemies at full health.
ability.aquamirae.terrible_fang.full.zh: 对满生命值敌人的伤害加成翻倍。

ability.aquamirae.terrible_cleaver.base.en: While injured, your attacks deal {bonus} increased damage against Ice Maze creatures.
ability.aquamirae.terrible_cleaver.base.zh: 受伤时，你的攻击对寒冰迷宫生物造成额外 {bonus} 伤害。

ability.aquamirae.terrible_cleaver.full.en: Your attacks have a {chance} chance to critically strike for {bonus} increased damage.
ability.aquamirae.terrible_cleaver.full.zh: 你的攻击有 {chance} 的几率造成暴击，并额外造成 {bonus} 伤害。

ability.aquamirae.shatterblade.base.en: Your attacks reduce the target's maximum health by {reduction} for {duration} seconds, stacking up to {max_stacks} times.
ability.aquamirae.shatterblade.base.zh: 你的攻击会使目标的最大生命值降低 {reduction}，持续 {duration} 秒，最多叠加 {max_stacks} 次。

ability.aquamirae.shatterblade.full.en: Your attacks deal {bonus} extra damage to enemies with maximum stacks.
ability.aquamirae.shatterblade.full.zh: 你的攻击会对拥有最大层数效果的敌人造成额外 {bonus} 伤害。

ability.aquamirae.shatterspike.base.en: Your attacks reduce the target's armor by {reduction} for {duration} seconds, stacking up to {max_stacks} times.
ability.aquamirae.shatterspike.base.zh: 你的攻击会使目标的护甲值降低 {reduction}，持续 {duration} 秒，最多叠加 {max_stacks} 次。

ability.aquamirae.shatterspike.full.en: Your attacks deal {bonus} extra damage to enemies with maximum stacks.
ability.aquamirae.shatterspike.full.zh: 你的攻击会对拥有最大层数效果的敌人造成额外 {bonus} 伤害。

ability.aquamirae.tidepiercer.en: Your attacks deal {bonus} increased damage underwater. Each block below sea level grants {per_block}, up to {max_bonus}.
ability.aquamirae.tidepiercer.zh: 你的攻击在水下造成额外 {bonus} 伤害。海平面以下每深入一格，伤害增加 {per_block}，最多增加至 {max_bonus}。

ability.aquamirae.dagger_of_greed.en: Your attacks have a {villager_chance} chance to make villagers drop an Emerald. Against pillagers, this chance is increased to {pillager_chance}. Each attack also has a {break_chance} chance to instantly break the weapon.
ability.aquamirae.dagger_of_greed.zh: 你的攻击有 {villager_chance} 的几率使村民掉落绿宝石。对灾厄村民时，该几率提高至 {pillager_chance}。每次攻击还有 {break_chance} 的几率使武器立即损坏。

tooltip.aquamirae.niveis_tear.en: Wisteria Niveis distilled. Stand in a Blizzard, and the Maelstrom will find you.
tooltip.aquamirae.niveis_tear.zh: 蒸馏后的雪紫藤精华。站在暴风雪中，大漩涡便会找到你。

tooltip.aquamirae.smithing_template.en: Armor forged from Ice Maze remains offers greater protection against its creatures.
tooltip.aquamirae.smithing_template.zh: 由寒冰迷宫遗骸锻造的盔甲，能够更好地抵御其中的生物。

tooltip.aquamirae.esca_skewer.en: Its eerie glow stirs an insatiable hunger.
tooltip.aquamirae.esca_skewer.zh: 诡异的光芒唤起了难以满足的饥饿。

tooltip.aquamirae.frozen_key.en: Opens a chest hidden in the depths of the Ice Maze.
tooltip.aquamirae.frozen_key.zh: 打开藏于寒冰迷宫深处的箱子。

tooltip.aquamirae.void_squid.en: Upon consuming, each hit drains 1 hunger shank instead of health. Starving rapidly drains health.
tooltip.aquamirae.void_squid.zh: 食用后，每次受到攻击都会消耗 1 格饥饿值而非生命值。饥饿会迅速消耗生命值。

tooltip.aquamirae.echo_compass.en: Resonates with the nearest Ship Graveyard Echo, attuned to its lingering call.
tooltip.aquamirae.echo_compass.zh: 与最近的海船墓地之回响产生共鸣，回应着它久久不散的召唤。

tooltip.aquamirae.ship_graveyard_echo.en: If you listen carefully, you can hear the horns of hundreds of ships lost in the Ice Maze...
tooltip.aquamirae.ship_graveyard_echo.zh: 仔细倾听，你可以听见数百艘迷失于寒冰迷宫中的船只所发出的号角声……

tooltip.aquamirae.wisteria_niveis.en: Even in the midst of an icy wasteland, a wonderful life can appear.
tooltip.aquamirae.wisteria_niveis.zh: 即使在冰冷的荒原之中，也能绽放出奇妙的生命。

tooltip.aquamirae.spinefish.en: Disguises itself as remains to avoid unwanted attention.
tooltip.aquamirae.spinefish.zh: 伪装成遗骸，以免受到不必要的关注。

tooltip.aquamirae.cooked_spinefish.en: Now it draws attention... especially with a side dish.
tooltip.aquamirae.cooked_spinefish.zh: 现在它反而会吸引注意……尤其是配上配菜之后。

tooltip.aquamirae.pirate_pouch.en: [color=light_purple]Right-click to open.[/color] [/br][/br] Only the stench remains, along with a hint of a once turbulent life.
tooltip.aquamirae.pirate_pouch.zh: [color=light_purple]右键打开。[/color] [/br][/br] 只剩下恶臭，以及曾经那段动荡生活的一丝痕迹。

tooltip.aquamirae.treasure_pouch.en: [color=light_purple]Right-click to open.[/color] [/br][/br] A treasure that outlasted the ship, the crew, and the very reason it was kept.
tooltip.aquamirae.treasure_pouch.zh: [color=light_purple]右键打开。[/color] [/br][/br] 这份宝藏熬过了船只、船员，甚至熬过了当初将它保存下来的理由。

tooltip.aquamirae.golden_moth_jar.en: Some treasures can have their own souls, not only devour others...
tooltip.aquamirae.golden_moth_jar.zh: 有些宝藏拥有自己的灵魂，而不仅仅是吞噬其他灵魂……

tooltip.aquamirae.luminescent_lamp.en: An eerie glow that never fades.

logbook.aquamirae.pirate_ship.content.en:
Entry #12

Last afternoon, Captain Cornelia went to the seabed in search of any additional resources. There are rumors among the crew that the real subject of her expedition is something else.

More than a day has passed since the captain's dive. She was wearing the only diving suit we had, so we couldn't help her in any way. Worst of all, she had the master key with her. As our hopes of rescue dwindle, the threat of rebellion grows.
logbook.aquamirae.pirate_ship.content.zh:
记录 #12

昨天下午，船长科妮莉亚下潜至海底，寻找更多资源。船员之间流传着传闻，说她此次远征真正的目的另有其物。

船长下潜已经超过一天了。她穿着我们唯一的一套潜水服，所以我们根本无法帮助她。最糟糕的是，万能钥匙也在她身上。随着获救的希望逐渐消逝，叛乱的威胁却与日俱增。

logbook.aquamirae.pirate_outpost.content.en:
Entry #34

These beasts from the depths prowl for someone to devour... One of those critters has already eaten our midshipman... Swallowed him whole along with his crossbow.

Entry #35

We are waiting in vain for rescue... No one will come to help us, we have to survive on our own. Today the construction of the fort from parts of the ship was completed. In any case, she could no longer plow the seas ever again.

Entry #36

We are no longer able to heat the fort, resources are running out. Part of the crew began to dig a shelter underground. It is the only way we have a chance not to freeze to death.

Entry #37

We hid our supplies and valuable cargo underground. But Poseidon cursed us, and during the storm the lieutenant washed away into the sea... Along with master keys.

The hope remains that we could possibly find similar keys on other ships of our fleet, which have suffered the same fate as us.
logbook.aquamirae.pirate_outpost.content.zh:
记录 #34

那些来自深海的野兽四处游荡，寻找可以吞噬的猎物……其中一只已经吃掉了我们的海军少尉……连同他的弩一起整个吞了下去。

记录 #35

我们苦等救援，却只是徒劳……不会有人来帮助我们，我们只能靠自己活下去。今天，用船体残骸建造的堡垒终于完工了。无论如何，这艘船再也不会航行于大海之上。

记录 #36

我们已经无法继续为堡垒供暖，资源正在耗尽。部分船员开始在地下挖掘避难所。这是我们唯一不至于冻死的办法。

记录 #37

我们将补给和贵重货物藏在了地下。但波塞冬诅咒了我们，暴风雨中，副官被冲进了海里……连同万能钥匙一起。

我们仍抱有一丝希望，也许能在舰队中其他遭遇同样命运的船上找到类似的钥匙。

logbook.aquamirae.pirate_shelter.content.en:
Entry #41

In these cursed lands there you can't find shelter even under the ice and the thickness of the earth... Some creatures that look like eels crawled out of the depths of the underworld, depriving us of the opportunity to return back to the surface.

Only the mistress of the moon knows how long shall we last... At all events, our hopes of seeing sunlight had all but vanished. This place will become our grave, our eternal tomb. For us and that damned rune...

Last Entry

It whispers to me, whispers inside my head the secrets of ice and snow... Ice... Now we are chained in ice forever...

I suppose a similar fate awaits the crew that set out in search of the fire rune... I wonder if they made it to the Great Dark Forest valley. Though it doesn't really matter now.
logbook.aquamirae.pirate_shelter.content.zh:
记录 #41

在这片被诅咒的土地上，即使躲在冰层和厚重的土地之下，也找不到真正的庇护……一些长得像鳗鱼的生物从地狱深处爬了出来，让我们再也无法回到地表。

只有月之女王知道我们还能坚持多久……无论如何，我们看到阳光的希望已经几乎消失殆尽。这里将成为我们的坟墓，我们永恒的长眠之所。也将成为那该死符文的坟墓……

最后记录

它在对我低语，在我的脑海中低语着冰与雪的秘密……冰……现在我们永远被冰封在这里了……

我想，前往寻找火焰符文的那支队伍也将遭遇相同的命运……不知道他们是否抵达了大黑暗森林的山谷。不过现在，这已经不重要了。

feedback.aquamirae.summon_captain_cornel.zh: 船长科妮莉亚的亡灵被唤醒了！
